characters.continuity: Pokémon Red and Blue / Standard Video Game Continuity
characters.summary: Golem is a massive Rock and Ground-type Pokémon that relies on its extremely durable boulder-like shell to withstand attacks while launching heavy physical blows and seismic movements. It can hurl its entire body or roll at enemies to crush them.

mechanisms: Thick stone shell providing high physical durability
Ability to shed its skin once a year to grow larger

limitations: Slow movement speed outside of rolling attacks
Vulnerable to elemental weaknesses like Water and Grass

sources.supports: Basic stats, typing, evolution, and abilities for Golem.

feats.claim: Can trigger an explosion that levels surrounding areas when it feels threatened.
feats.citation: Pokémon Red and Blue Pokédex entries

campaignTags.claim: Golem is documented as standing 4'07" tall and weighing a massive 661.4 lbs, featuring a bulky boulder body.

unknowns: Exact capabilities in competitive formats versus in-universe lore may vary.
